title: Annual CO2 emissions from fossil fuels
hook: Witness the historical shift in annual CO2 emissions from fossil fuels over nearly two centuries.
setup: This animation traces the changing levels of annual CO2 emissions from fossil fuels across nations from 1830 to 2023.

sequence.text: France appears among the early recorded entities in 1830.
Chile appears as a newcomer to the rankings in 1843.
Italy and Czechia enter the recorded entities in 1860.
Japan enters the rankings for the first time in 1888.
China appears in the rankings in 1906.
Mexico joins the recorded entities in 1916.
United States reaches an emissions level of 5131760600 in 1990.
China reaches a high value of 12172008000 by 2023.

ending: The race highlights the long-term evolution of annual CO2 emissions from fossil fuels.
